text:
emma: Heads-up — SigmaSilicon reached out, they want an interop run next week with their prototype boards. Goal: end-to-end latency + throughput + KV-cache stability on int8 + fp16. They asked us to sign a short data addendum by Friday. @sigma_pm can you confirm shipment window and which model variants you want tested?

sigma_pm: We can ship 2 dev boards Mon/Tue. Targets: 2B and 13B model families. We'll request int8 q4 runs and a fp16 baseline. We'll send a one-page confidentiality addendum (not a full NDA) — need it signed by Fri local time.

emma: Nice — thanks. Quick checklist then: legal review, bench script, telemetry contract, ops provisioning, sample prompt set.

raj: Do we have the int8 kernels ready for the runtime path they want? If not, I can carve out a branch to toggle kernel selection.

sophia: For the eval set, can we reuse our standard regression + safety slices? I’ll assemble a 200-sample set (mix of doc, code, safety). Need to know telemetry constraints first.

matt-legal: I need to see exactly what telemetry fields they want. No raw prompt content can leave Redwood VPC. Acceptable: hashed prompt id, token counts, latency/p50/p95, memory and CPU samples. Anything else requires explicit consent. @sigma_pm are you ok with hash-only prompts?

sigma_pm: Hash-only and aggregate token counts are fine. If we need deeper traces later we can do an air-gapped transfer under retention limits. We'll sign the addendum for that.

oliver-sre: For lab setup we'll need a jump host, VLAN config, and a temporary account for Sigma eng. Security will require MFA and ephemeral creds. Also need to confirm power and rack U.

emma: Action items: 1) Matt to review addendum, 2) Raj to prepare bench branch and runbook, 3) Sophia to pick prompt set and scrub PII, 4) Oliver to provision access and open change request. Target: scripts + signed addendum by Thu EOD so boards can ship Fri. Demo target internal: Mar 30.

bench-bot: New bench seed created: bench/sigma-interop/1765432100. Use `bench-run --sigma --report-s3 s3://redwood-sigma`. Follow infra anonymization flags.

raj: I'll push branch `sigma/1765432100-int8` with a runbook. Example run:```bash
./run_bench.sh --model gpt-13b-q4 --quant int8 --use-kv-cache --anonymize
```I'll also include fallbacks to fp16 if int8 kernel not available.

sophia: I'll prepare 200 prompts: 50 safety, 50 docs, 100 code. Will scrub PII, produce salted SHA256 hashes for each prompt, and include a mapping file (hash -> sample-id) that stays internal.

matt-legal: Quick Q: Will Sigma request raw logs for kernel debugging? If yes, need explicit clause and a retention window. @sigma_pm please confirm now so I can draft.

sigma_pm: We may ask for sample logs for debugging but only via an air-gapped transfer and under 7-day retention. Hash-only data + perf metrics OK by default.

emma: Great. If legal signs off, proceed. I'll book a 1hr kickoff Tue with Sigma and schedule a Wed morning bench smoke demo.

oliver-sre: I'll open the lab change request and create the temporary account. Security will require SSO invite + ephemeral keys and MFA.

bench-bot: Reminder: always run with `--anonymize` flag when uploading to S3. Infra runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sigma-interop (internal link).

sophia: Proposed telemetry sampling: 5% on production-like prompt patterns to limit volume. Any objections?

raj: Fine by me. Also will validate NV kernels on our CI images; if absent we'll fallback to fp16 runs and note that in the results.

matt-legal: I'll circulate a short addendum draft by EOD for quick sign-off and cc @emma.

emma: Thanks everyone — I'll confirm shipping address + demo invite list. Onward :rocket:
